goal: The first screen names the sprint that really merged

wentWrong.what: The first screen named the wrong sprint as the last one merged
wentWrong.evidence: Production, 2026-11-20: / and /crew read "Crew resting. Sprint 32 merged." and "Replay sprint 32" after sprint 82 merged as #159; /api/crew carried sprint 32 beside PR #159, and sprint 32 merged on 25 Oct as #82

proposals.change: The Studio (the owner's repository) takes a run's sprint number from its branch or PR, not the first .crew/sprint/<n>/ path a run touches; every run touches .crew/sprint/32/merge-record.mjs first
proposals.moves: Misnumbered runs in the feed, 1 seen (sprint 82 told as 32)

followUps.what: Pin the feed's renumbering in e2e: a held PR with a wrong number, and an unknown PR with a merged number (Lens's nit)
A live run before its PR opens can still draw a pencil on a merged plank; moving the fixtures' in-progress numbers off merged sprints closes it
Lens's nit: numbered() parses the whole run to read two fields; a narrow helper would say so
